command: cd /tmp && sed -n "$(grep -n '    Routine:' openapi.yaml | cut -d: -f1),+10p" openapi.yaml; echo ===BW; sed -n "$(grep -n '    BodyweightEntry:' openapi.yaml | cut -d: -f1),+10p" openapi.yaml

data:
===BW
    BodyweightEntry:
      type: object
      description: >-
        One day of weigh-ins. `w` is the day's one value, the one the profile's `bwDaily`
        setting picks from `ins` (first, the default; avg; last), so a reader that knows nothing
        of `ins` gets the same number the app charts. A day from before v1.4.4 has no `ins`: one
        weigh-in without a time. A client that writes `w` and `t` of a day with `ins` (an older
        app correcting the day) has that taken as a correction of the weigh-in `w` came from.
      properties:
        d: { type: string, format: date }
        w: { type: number, description: "The day's weight in `unit` (see the description)." }
